label: Create Voice
description: Mint a designed preview (from Design Voice) into a durable voice on the account. The minted voice id works in every speak node from then on.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the minted voice lives in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The new voice's name on the account.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: The voice description (kept with the voice).

inputs.name: previewId
inputs.description: The chosen preview's voiceId from Design Voice.

outputs.name: voiceId
outputs.description: The minted voice's id: what the speak nodes take.
